[[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]] | number = 23 | nationality = French | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1995|5|9|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Cannes]], France | highschool = | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2012 | career_end = | years1 = 2012–2015 | team1 = [[Olympique Antibes]] | years2 = 2015–present | team2 = [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Leks]] | highlights = * [[Radivoj Korać Cup|Serbian Cup]] winner ([[2015–16 Radivoj Korać Cup|2016]]) * All-ABA League Team ([[2015–16 ABA League#The ideal five and coach of the season|2016]]) }} '''Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot''' (born May 9, 1995) is a French professional [[basketball]] player who plays for [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Leks]] of the [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]]. ==Club career== Luwawu played with [[Olympique Antibes]] from 2012 until 2015. In the 2014–15 season he played with Antibes in [[LNB Pro B]] (who had previously played there in Luwawu's first two years before being promoted to the [[LNB Pro A]] for one season) and averaged 6.9 points, 2.5 rebounds and 1.4 assists. He helped the team win the Pro B [[Leaders Cup]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Luwawu-cabarrot-la-pepite-d-antibes/538011|title=Luwawu-Cabarrot, la pépite d'Antibes|website=L'Equipe.fr|language=fr-FR|access-date=2016-03-03}} In February 2015, he announced that he planned on entering the [[2015 NBA draft]],{{cite web|title=France's Timothe Luwawu-Cabarrot Plans Early Entry In NBA Draft|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/236476/Frances-Timothe-Luwawu-Cabarrot-Plans-Early-Entry-In-NBA-Draft|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=15 April 2015}} but eventually wasn't part of it. On July 5, 2015, he signed a contract with the Serbian team [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Leks]].{{cite news|title=Mega Leks signs Timothe Luwawu-Cabarrot and Alpha Kaba|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/serbia/167233/mega-leks-signs-timothe-luwawu-cabarrot-and-alpha-kaba.html|accessdate=15 November 2015|work=sportando.com|date=5 July 2015}} During this time in Serbia, he helped become a major part in winning the Serbian Cup, as well as making it to the All-Adriatic League Team. On April 11, 2016, it was announced Luwawu would participate in the [[2016 NBA Draft]], alongside his teammates [[Ivica Zubac]] and [[Rade Zagorac]] (while both [[Ognjen Jaramaz]] and fellow [[French]]man [[Alpha Kaba]] had expressed interest in entering as well, they ultimately declined their entries). Because he had already previously expressed his desires on entering the NBA Draft in 2015, he cannot back out once again this year. He'd be one of 13 international underclassmen (including one of four different Frenchmen) to declare for the [[2016 NBA Draft]]. ==International career== Luwawu was member of [[France national basketball team|France]] in youth international events:{{cite web|title=Timothe Luwawu Player Profile|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Timothe-Luwawu/Summary/46508|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=15 April 2015}} He played at the 2014{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.season_2014.roundID_10029.teamID_282.playerID_107611.html|title=Timothe Luwawu {{!}} U20 European Championship Men (2014) {{!}} FIBA Europe|website=www.fibaeurope.com|access-date=2016-03-03}} and 2015 U20 European Championships. In 2015, he helped the French team to a semifinal appearance, while averaging 11.6 points and 4.9 rebounds a contest during the tournament,{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.season_2015.roundID_11586.teamID_282.playerID_107611.html|title=Timothe Luwawu {{!}} U20 European Championship Men (2015) {{!}} FIBA Europe|website=www.fibaeurope.com|access-date=2016-03-03}} earning All-Tournament Honorable Mention status by Eurobasket.com.{{Cite web|url=http://www.eurobasket.com/European-Championships-U20/basketball_2015.asp|title=European Championships U20 Basketball, Teams, Scores, Stats, News, Standings - eurobasket.com|website=www.eurobasket.com|access-date=2016-03-03}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.aba-liga.com/League/Player.aspx?id=2446 Timothé Luwawu] at aba-liga.com * [http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Timothe-Luwawu-68219/ Timothé Luwawu] at draftexpress.com {{KK Mega Vizura current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Luwawu, Timothe}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Expatriate basketball people in Serbia]] [[Category:French basketball players]] [[Category:KK Mega Vizura players]] [[Category:People from Cannes]] {{France-basketball-bio-stub}}
